## [Perceptual quality controller: SSIMULACRA2 score target for Fast and Balanced, gated Quality effort](ROADMAP.md#perceptual-quality-controller-ssimulacra2-score-target-for-fast-and-balanced-gated-quality-effort) `@jpegxl-rs.track.perceptual-quality-controller/1`

### Unify rate and quality search around a shared quantizer-ladder navigation engine

`active` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.ladder-navigator-unification/3` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.perceptual-quality-controller/1`

Extract a common ladder-navigation engine from rate.rs and quality.rs in three behavior-preserving phases: N0 move Rung/QuantizerChoice/effective_scale/rung_for_effective_scale/coupled_quant_lf into quantizer_ladder.rs; N1 replace the duplicated log-domain crossing math (interpolated_rung, two_anchor_target_rung, target_rung_from_slope; log_loss_crossing, extrapolated_step, geometric_step) with one navigation.rs (LocalModel, Constraint::Ceiling/Floor, coordinate transforms y=ln(bytes) and y=-ln(max(100-score,eps))); N2 a stateful LadderNavigator (NavigationObservation with Authority::Surrogate/Canonical, NavigationPrior, NavigationBudget, no-repeat cache, bracket discovery, crossing tightening) with rate and quality as objective adapters. Byte-rate specifics (never-over ceiling, non-monotone pockets, LF fill, entropy tiers, maximize-bytes ranking) stay in rate.rs; perceptual specifics (canonical render+metric acceptance, score guard, policy bank, reducer) stay in quality.rs. Unify where to probe; never unify what a probe means or what constitutes a valid final answer. Narrative plan: JPXL/docs/scheduler-unification-and-multifidelity-plan.md.

### One-shot program: shadow-first common-case one-shot quality controller

`active` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.pqc-one-shot-controller/3` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.perceptual-quality-controller/1`

### Multi-fidelity perceptual search: surrogates propose, canonical evaluation accepts

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.multifidelity-quality-search/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.perceptual-quality-controller/1`

On top of the unified LadderNavigator, make most navigation probes cheap while every accepted result stays exact. Phases: N3 confidence-adaptive probe budgets driven by predict_v2 (interval width, saturation_risk, ood_flags select 0-2 surrogate probes and a 1-2 canonical budget; the preset 3/5 canonical caps remain the emergency ceiling; conservative in-interval first probe, then residual-corrected second candidate); S1 a surrogate NavigationEvaluator (half-linear-resolution reconstruction, surviving SSIMULACRA2 scales, Authority::Surrogate) that may only propose - QualityOutcome must be backed by a canonical full-resolution SSIMULACRA2 score, with one canonical correction on miss then fallback to the full navigator; S2 a banded renderer-to-metric pipeline built exact first (band EPF+halo, XYB, horizontal blur, per-column vertical recurrence state, original-pixel-order f64 pooling preserved), then a decimating surrogate variant. Independent exact work R1: per-worker RenderScratch and dequantize_into/idct_into/render_varblock_into in jpxl-plan-render, removing per-varblock CoeffMatrix/SampleBlock/RenderedVarblock/sigma_writes allocation and chunk staging. Conditional later: paired-candidate SIMD lanes (B1), blur/EPF/XYB exact micro-work (E1), rate-path fused multi-rung quantization and a learned rate prior (RT1/RT2). Narrative plan: JPXL/docs/scheduler-unification-and-multifidelity-plan.md.

### EXIF box and colour-space signalling for the archive pipeline

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.pipeline-metadata-seam/1`

Give the archive pipeline the two metadata seams it needs from the
encoder: a Part 2 Exif container box exposed as Encoder::with_exif
(validated raw-TIFF payload, container implied), and declarative
colour-space signalling (sRGB, linear sRGB, Display P3, Rec.2020)
through the Annex E ColourEncoding bundle on the lossless Modular
path, with lossy VarDCT rejecting non-sRGB input by typed error
because XYB and the metric are defined on sRGB. Downstream,
raw-autotune supplies the TIFF blob and colour tag and openarc
routes them through archiving; the contract is a bare TIFF blob,
never an APP1 wrapper.
